question: The machine will not move / won't drive

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jason with Etnyre Customer Support. What can I help you with today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The machine will not move / won't drive

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem at all. Go into the RC-36 controller's diagnostics menu, scroll down to Drive Status and read off what it says there. That'll tell us straight away whether it's the pump or the joystick.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Done. What is the next step?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good. Next, unplug the electrical connector on the brake pressure switch on the hose from the foot pedal, start the machine, and try to move it. If it moves, that switch is your problem.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Done. What is the next step?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one. Put a gauge in port G on the drive pump. At low idle you're looking for around five hundred and fifty to six hundred PSI - anything under that and your charge pump is on the way out. And when you refit the gauge, torque the fitting to twelve foot-pounds so you don't crack the port.
